title: Democracy in the age of AI: media trust and political engagement
discussion_signal: The post presents European survey findings on AI’s risks and opportunities for democracy, concern about AI-generated election content, trust in traditional media, and support for transparency rules. It directly links information opacity to participation and democratic satisfaction.
linked_research_question: How do unfamiliar participatory tools, AI opacity, and distrust in information affect democratic participation and legitimacy?
limits: The post summarizes a separate survey rather than the atlas source itself
Survey wording and sampling require primary-source review
Reported associations do not establish causal effects on participation
